import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        int[] inputA = Arrays.stream(br.readLine().trim().split(" ")).mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();
        int[] inputB = Arrays.stream(br.readLine().trim().split(" ")).mapToInt(Integer::parseInt).toArray();

        int[] inputA2 = inputA.clone();
        int[] inputB2 = inputB.clone();

        System.out.println((n - getLostMaxFast(inputA2, inputB2)) + " " + getWonMaxFast(inputA, inputB));
    }

    private static int getWonMaxFast(int[] inputA, int[] inputB) {
        int[] wins = {0, 0, 0};
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int good = (i + 1) % 3;
            wins[i] = Math.min(inputA[i], inputB[good]);
            inputA[i] -= wins[i];
            inputB[good] -= wins[i];
        }
        int sum = 0;
        for (int w : wins) {
            sum += w;
        }
        return sum;
    }

    private static int getLostMaxFast(int[] inputA, int[] inputB) {
        int[][][] waysToLose = {
            {{0, 2}},
            {{1, 0}},
            {{2, 1}},
            {{0, 0}},
            {{1, 1}},
            {{2, 2}}
        };
        List<int[][]> allPermutations = new ArrayList<>();
        generatePermutations(waysToLose, 0, allPermutations);
        int maxLost = 0;

        for (int[][] permutation : allPermutations) {
            int[] losts = {0, 0, 0};
            int[] inputACopy = inputA.clone();
            int[] inputBCopy = inputB.clone();
            for (int[] wayToLose : permutation) {
                int lost_add = Math.min(inputACopy[wayToLose[0]], inputBCopy[wayToLose[1]]);
                inputACopy[wayToLose[0]] -= lost_add;
                inputBCopy[wayToLose[1]] -= lost_add;
                losts[wayToLose[0]] += lost_add;
            }
            int lostSum = 0;
            for (int l : losts) {
                lostSum += l;
            }
            if (lostSum > maxLost) {
                maxLost = lostSum;
            }
        }
        return maxLost;
    }

    private static void generatePermutations(int[][][] ways, int index, List<int[][]> permutations) {
        if (index == ways.length) {
            int[][] permutation = new int[ways.length][2];
            for (int i=0; i<ways.length; i++) {
                permutation[i][0] = ways[i][0][0];
                permutation[i][1] = ways[i][0][1];
            }
            permutations.add(permutation);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < ways.length; i++) {
            generatePermutations(ways, index + 1, permutations);
        }
    }
}
